# Magic Room

> Magic Room is an AI interior design tool that redesigns any room from a single photo in 30–60 seconds (about 2 minutes at Ultra quality) using multimodal image models from Google Gemini and OpenAI. Uploaded photos are processed in memory and never stored on a server. Pricing is one-time credits from €9.99 with no subscription.

Last updated: 2026-11-01
Founder and author: Thanos Kazakis (https://www.linkedin.com/in/thanos-kazakis-922977205/)
Full knowledge file: https://magic-room.dev/llms-full.txt
Machine-readable pricing: https://magic-room.dev/pricing.md

## What Magic Room does

A user uploads one photo of a real room, picks a design theme and a room type, and the AI returns a photorealistic redesign of that exact room in the chosen style. The original room geometry — walls, windows, floor, doorways — is preserved; only styling, finishes, and furnishings change. Outputs are used as renovation planning references, real-estate virtual staging, and interior-design client presentations.

## Core facts

- Quality tiers and models (via OpenRouter): Quick uses google/gemini-nano-banana-2.1 (1 credit); Pro uses google/gemini-3-pro-image (2 credits); Ultra uses openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 (3 credits) and keeps the room's layout most closely.
- Why multimodal matters: the model reads image and text together, so it reasons about the room's spatial structure instead of applying a 2D style filter over it.
- Generation time: 30–60 seconds for Quick and Pro, about 2 minutes for Ultra, returned synchronously — no queue, no polling.
- Outputs: one redesigned image per generation.
- Styles selectable in the generator (14): Modern, Minimalist, Scandinavian, Industrial, Tropical, Bohemian, Vintage, Luxury, Japandi, Art Deco, Coastal, Farmhouse, Mediterranean, Transitional. An optional note (up to 500 characters) adds any other detail.
- Room types selectable in the generator (14): Living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, dining room, office, gaming room, nursery, laundry room, basement, sunroom, home theater, mudroom, walk-in closet.
- Privacy: images are transmitted as base64, held in memory for the duration of the request, then dropped. No storage bucket write, no database write, no use for AI training.
- Pricing: one-time credit packs — €9.99 / 20 credits, €19.99 / 60 credits, €29.99 / 120 credits. No subscription. Credits never expire. A Quick design costs €0.25–€0.50 depending on the pack; Pro costs twice that, Ultra three times.
- Free trial: 1 credit on signup (one Quick design), no payment card required.
- Commercial rights: included on every paid credit. Free-credit generations are personal use only.
- Rate limit: 100 generations per hour per account.
- Stack: Next.js on Vercel, Clerk authentication, Stripe one-time checkout, Supabase for the credit balance only.

## Verifiable differentiators

| Claim | How it is implemented |
|---|---|
| Photos are never stored | The image is sent as base64 straight to the model API, held in request memory, then discarded. There is no bucket write and no image column in the database. |
| Credits never expire | Credits are an integer balance on the user row that only decrements on use. There is no monthly reset job. |
| No subscription exists | Stripe Checkout is configured for one-time payments only; no recurring subscription object is ever created. |
| Room geometry is preserved | The model processes the photo and the prompt together, reasoning about the room's spatial structure rather than overlaying a style. |
| Failed generations are refunded | If the model call fails, the credit is returned to the account automatically. |

## Honest limitations

- Magic Room redesigns interior rooms only. It does not do exterior, landscape, or floor-plan generation.
- Output is a visualisation, not a construction document or a furniture shopping list.
- Because photos are never stored, generations are not retained in an account history after the session.
- Free-credit output carries no commercial rights.
